# HydroPal

## Problem Statement

The proposed system utilizes a dense hydrogen-palladium core as a moderator to absorb radiation from heavy metal outer layers, theoretically converting nuclear decay into contained, emissionless energy [1]. Corporate reluctance to adopt hydrogen, often attributed to figures like [Elon Musk](https://www.google.com/search?q=elon+musk&kgmid=/m/03nzf1#), stems from low round-trip efficiency, the need for new infrastructure, and a lack of profit in long-lasting, self-sustaining technologies [2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].
